Detect peaks in a chromatographic trace

detect_peaks.Rd

Finds resolved peaks (local maxima) and, optionally, unresolved shoulders (second-derivative minima) in an FID trace or a TIC.

Usage

detect_peaks(
  trace,
  min_snr = NULL,
  smooth_window = NULL,
  include_shoulders = TRUE
)

Arguments

trace

List with numeric rt and intensity (e.g. exp$fid).

min_snr

Numeric; minimum apex height as a multiple of the noise. NULL uses the moosaic.peak_min_height_snr option.

smooth_window

Odd integer; Savitzky-Golay smoothing window in points for the detection copy. NULL uses the moosaic.fid_smooth_window option, which is tuned for the FID sampling rate.

include_shoulders

Logical; if TRUE, each shoulder is returned as its own row.

Value

A tibble, sorted by apex_rt, with columns:

  • peak_id: integer, 1..n in retention order.

  • apex_rt, start_rt, end_rt: apex and bounds (min).

  • height: smoothed signal at the apex, above the estimated baseline.

  • has_shoulder: logical; the resolved peak contains at least one unresolved shoulder. Always FALSE on shoulder rows.

  • is_shoulder: logical; the row is a shoulder (apex at a second-derivative minimum) rather than a resolved maximum.

  • parent_id: integer; for shoulder rows the peak_id of the resolved peak containing it, otherwise NA.

Zero rows when nothing is detected.

Details

Detection runs on a smoothed, baseline-corrected copy; the input is never modified. Maxima that do not rise at least half the SNR threshold above their neighbouring valley are discarded as noise.

Shoulders are heuristic and conservative for noisy or narrow peaks. When shoulders are returned, the parent peak's span is split between the apex and its shoulders at the midpoints between neighbouring apexes, so rows do not overlap and their union equals the parent's original span.

Examples

rt <- seq(0, 2, length.out = 2000)
trace <- list(rt = rt, intensity = 100 * exp(-0.5 * ((rt - 1) / 0.03)^2))
detect_peaks(trace)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 8
#>   peak_id apex_rt start_rt end_rt height has_shoulder is_shoulder parent_id
#>     <int>   <dbl>    <dbl>  <dbl>  <dbl> <lgl>        <lgl>           <int>
#> 1       1    1.00    0.939   1.06   75.8 FALSE        FALSE              NA
